description: Interview prep plans created by authenticated users.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key for each prep plan.

columns.name: daily_minutes
columns.description: Recommended daily prep time in minutes.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Authenticated user who owns the plan.

columns.name: plan_data
columns.description: Form payload for nested fields like topics, topic confidence, question types, notes, mode, and preferences.

notes: This schema keeps the core table small and predictable.
Nested UI data that does not need dedicated columns is stored under plan_data.
This avoids over-normalizing until the app needs specific reporting or filtering columns.
